descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Why do we do what we do? 
 We inspire one another to share our tech-works in this amazing and abundant world. So we became developers, innovators, thinkers, software builders, and hardware makers!
 Our Vision! 
 Founded in 2006 with 650+ engineers & global presence (8 delivery centers in Europe & North America) we strive to become a leading East-European technology partner for growing organizations in need of digital transformation of their products and services!
 What you’ll do 
Work hands-on with RTOS concepts and implementations, either AUTOSAR-based or non-AUTOSAR, such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr
Develop new software functionality in C and Assembly, focusing on product development rather than maintenance or integration-only activities
Design, implement, and maintain embedded real-time software components for NXP microcontrollers supporting AUTOSAR and non-AUTOSAR contexts, for diverse architectures (ARM Cortex A/M/R52) and toolchains (GCC, IAR, GHS, DIAB)
Debug complex issues on embedded targets and analyze low-level behavior using embedded debugging techniques and tools. The examples include experience with debugging software on embedded systems and highlight strong debugging skills
Collaborate with local and international engineering teams, align technical concepts, propose solutions, estimate effort, and track progress
 What you need to be successful 
Strong programming experience (ANSI C)
Good understanding and practical usage of Assembly language in embedded software development, debugging or low-level optimization
Solid understanding of CPU / Computer architecture and low-level system concepts
Strong hands-on experience with RTOS development, either AUTOSAR-based or non-AUTOSAR, including FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar real-time operating systems
Familiarity with version control systems (Git or similar)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across multiple software layers
English language (spoken and written)
 Nice to have 
Knowledge of real time hypervisor would be considered a plus
 What we offer you to be successful 
Flexible working environment, ability to work remotely or in a hybrid model, depending on your project requirements.
Work with worldwide technology leaders - We partner and deliver technology to industry giants like Intel, NXP, Panasonic, Visteon, Carrefour, Windriver, Kardex, METRO Digital, and many others.
Priority Plus Medical Subscription @Regina Maria (fully covered by the company)
Mental Health Online Resources through the Hilio Wellbeing Platform
Flexible benefits worth 1300 RON gross per month - you can choose the ones that suit your preference
We have profit shares schemed that enable you to financially benefit from the new business you identify
We have premium referral bonus for each successful recommendation you make - (500-1500 EUR NET based on seniority)
Enjoy our vibrant offices in Romania's top IT hubs – Bucharest, Timisoara, Cluj, and Iasi, perfect for when you want to grab a coffee with your colleagues.
Community – No man is an island, we stay connected through ongoing learning, project rotation, idea incubation, as well as through our Football Team, Townhalls, and Fun Thursday Office Day!
